question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

Many of these losses were due to the utter __incompetence__ of the higher command.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"incompetence"** means lack of skill, ability, or qualifications. (अयोग्यता)

 
 
• **Example: **The company failed due to the** incompetence** of its management.
 
 
 
• **"Adept" **refers to someone who is highly skilled or proficient at something. (निपुण)
 
 
• **Example: **She is **adept** at playing the piano.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'incompetence' **is **'adept'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Inability **(असमर्थता): Lack of power, skill, or means to do something.

 
 
• **Example:** His inability to understand the instructions caused the delay.
 
 
 
• **Boredom **(उबाऊपन): The state of feeling bored or uninterested.
 
 
• **Example: **She felt a sense of boredom during the long lecture.
 
 
 
• **Lacuna **(रिक्तता): An unfilled space or gap.
 
 
• **Example:** There was a lacuna in the historical records.
